claims.claim_text: Linde plc reports total sales of $32,854 million for fiscal year 2023, compared to $33,364 million in 2022 and $30,793 million in 2021, with approximately 68% of 2023 sales generated outside the United States.
claims.source_quote: Linde s sales were $32,854 million, $33,364 million, and $30,793 million for 2023, 2022, and 2021, respectively ... Linde is a global enterprise with approximately 68% of its 2023 sales outside of the United States.
claims.subject: Linde plc
claims.extraction_notes: Consolidated revenue and geographic mix are internal accounting figures audited by KPMG; no external registry independently adjudicates a multinational's total sales or geographic split. Audited financials are canonical.

claims.claim_text: Linde is positioned to capture growing hydrogen demand from U.S. Inflation Reduction Act incentives that fund clean-hydrogen production and decarbonization technologies, with hydrogen sales expected to continue growing.
claims.source_quote: Examples include current legislation, such as the Inflation Reduction Act in the U.S., which provides for investments in production of clean hydrogen and decarbonization technologies ... Linde anticipates continued growth in hydrogen sales due to increased focus on decarbonization projects.
claims.subject: Linde plc
claims.extraction_notes: Counterparty / external corroboration: count SEC filings (across all filers) referencing Linde in the post-IRA window. A genuinely IRA-leveraged industrial-gas leader should generate substantial customer/partner cross-references in 10-Ks and 8-Ks of energy and chemical filers.

claims.claim_text: Linde operates approximately 350 production facilities in the Americas segment (mainly cryogenic air separation, hydrogen, and CO2 plants) with five major North American pipeline complexes in northern Indiana, Houston, the Gulf Coast of Texas, Detroit, and Louisiana.
claims.source_quote: The Americas segment operates production facilities primarily in the U.S., Canada, Mexico and Brazil, approximately 350 of which are mainly cryogenic air separation plants, hydrogen plants and carbon dioxide plants. There are five major pipeline complexes in North America located in northern Indiana, Houston, along the Gulf Coast of Texas, Detroit and Louisiana.
claims.subject: Linde plc Americas segment
claims.object_value: ~350 Americas facilities; 5 major NA pipeline complexes
claims.extraction_notes: Texas Gulf Coast hub is the most concentrated U.S. cluster (hydrogen + ASU pipelines). EPA FRS should return many Linde-named permitted facilities in TX, providing strong corroboration. State-by-state checks (IN, MI, LA) would extend coverage but are not required to validate the existence of the Americas footprint.

claims.claim_text: Linde acquired nexAir, LLC during 2023, and net acquisitions (primarily nexAir) increased Americas segment sales by 3% in 2023 versus 2022.
claims.source_quote: Sales for the Americas segment increased $430 million, or 3%, in 2023 versus 2022. Higher pricing contributed 6% to sales. The impact of net acquisitions increased sales by 3% primarily due to the acquisition of nexAir, LLC.
claims.subject: nexAir, LLC
claims.extraction_notes: Material M&A activity by a $30B+ revenue acquirer should produce a press 8-K and recurring 10-Q references. Verify multiple SEC filings reference 'nexAir' between announcement and cutoff.

claims.claim_text: Linde owns a large portfolio of patents covering industrial-gas processing, separation, liquefaction, hydrogen, synthesis gas, and clean-energy technologies that the company describes as a competitive advantage.
claims.source_quote: Linde owns or licenses a large number of patents that relate to a wide variety of products and processes. Linde s patents expire at various times over the next 20 years ... This results in the development of new advanced air separation, hydrogen, synthesis gas, natural gas, adsorption and chemical process technologies; novel clean energy and carbon management solutions.
claims.subject: Linde plc
claims.object_value: large patent portfolio in industrial gases / hydrogen / clean energy
claims.extraction_notes: Large industrial-gas incumbent should have hundreds of granted U.S. patents under 'Linde' assignment. Title categorization should show non-zero hydrogen and air-separation buckets, consistent with stated R&D priorities. Absence of meaningful patent volume would be inconsistent with the 'pioneer / leader' framing.

claims.claim_text: Linde reports it operates in more than 80 countries and had 66,323 employees worldwide as of December 31, 2023.
claims.source_quote: Linde serves a diverse group of industries across more than 80 countries ... As of December 31, 2023, Linde had 66,323 employees worldwide comprised of approximately 28 percent women and 72 percent men.
claims.subject: Linde plc
claims.extraction_notes: Employee headcount and country footprint are internal disclosures with no authoritative external registry. Not structurally adjudicatable by an external M-source.

claims.claim_text: Linde and its subsidiaries hold approximately $3,344 million of outstanding letters of credit, guarantees, and surety bonds from financial institutions, primarily related to customer contract performance guarantees (including plant construction in connection with on-site contracts) and self-insurance.
claims.source_quote: guarantees and surety bonds valued at approximately $3,344 million from financial institutions. These relate primarily to customer contract performance guarantees (including plant construction in connection with certain on-site contracts), self-insurance claims and other commercial and governmental requirements.
claims.subject: Linde plc
claims.extraction_notes: Verify Linde's own SEC filing cadence is consistent (annual 10-K plus 4 10-Qs per year) so the guarantee disclosure is recurring and trackable. Material commitments of $3B+ should recur quarter-over-quarter; missing or inconsistent filings would be a red flag.

claims.claim_text: Linde claims to be the largest industrial gas company worldwide, with competitors including L'Air Liquide S.A., Air Products and Chemicals, Inc., Messer Group GmbH, and Mitsubishi Chemical Holdings (through Taiyo Nippon Sanso).
claims.source_quote: Linde is the largest industrial gas company worldwide ... Competitors in the industrial gases industry include global and regional companies such as L Air Liquide S.A., Air Products and Chemicals, Inc., Messer Group GmbH, Mitsubishi Chemical Holdings Corporation (through Taiyo Nippon Sanso Corporation).
claims.subject: Linde plc

proposed_connector.name: industry_ranking.market_share_registry
proposed_connector.description: Public industry-association or government-statistics registry of industrial-gas global market share by company (e.g. gasworld annual league tables, Eurostat NACE-code aggregates, or USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries for industrial gases).
proposed_connector.endpoint: https://www.gasworld.com/ (Top 20 industrial gas suppliers annual report) or https://www.usgs.gov/centers/national-minerals-information-center (industrial gas commodity summaries)
proposed_connector.sample_invocation: GET https://www.gasworld.com/top-20-industrial-gas-suppliers/<YEAR>/ and parse the ranked supplier table; or query USGS commodity summaries for industrial-gas market data
proposed_connector.rationale: Market-leadership claims ('largest in the world') require an independent industry aggregator or government statistics body to adjudicate. SEC filings of named competitors (Air Liquide, APD) cross-reference revenue but rank ordering requires a multi-company comparison source.
proposed_connector.completeness: public industry association coverage; not all peers are SEC filers (Messer, Linde are mixed jurisdictions)

claims.extraction_notes: Market-share rank is not directly available in any current m_source_catalog connector. Cross-check via competitor 10-Ks is partial (APD/Air Liquide file SEC filings but a global ranking needs a market-research aggregator). Proposed connector would scrape annual industry league tables.
